title: Automatic Sweep: Defining Excess Fund Thresholds
summary: This document explains how “Automatic Sweep” uses two thresholds: a target minimum checking balance of $500 and a minimum sweep amount of 50. It states that no sweep occurs when calculated excess is below 50; otherwise, it sweeps only the amount above $500.
faqs: What are the two excess fund thresholds I can set for Automatic Sweep?
